issues.title: Broken Internal Cross-References
issues.why: The Feature Inventory in 00-overview.md references files like 01-ci-pipeline.md and 02-release-pipeline.md in the root, but the Consistency Report (99-consistency-report.md) and actual file list show these are often duplicated or shadowed by subfolder versions, leading to path resolution ambiguity for an AI.
issues.fix: Consolidate root-level generic specs into a single 'templates' folder and use absolute-style paths from the spec root in all inventories.

issues.title: Boilerplate-Only Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: The 97-acceptance-criteria.md files for both the root and subfolders contain only 'tree-health' and 'naming convention' checks. They lack GWT criteria for the actual logic (e.g., SHA-deduplication logic, source-map removal, or checksum generation).
issues.fix: Add GWT cases for SHA-cache hit/miss behavior and artifact packaging constraints (e.g., 'Given a build with .map files, When packaged, Then .zip contains 0 .map files').

issues.title: Concurrency Race Condition in SHA-Deduplication
issues.why: The SHA-deduplication pattern in 01-ci-pipeline.md describes inlining cache writes to prevent races, but doesn't specify how to handle multiple parallel workflows (e.g., push + PR) hitting the cache-save step simultaneously.
issues.fix: Add a requirement to use unique cache keys per workflow type or implement a 'check-then-set' lock using a secondary cache key.
